title: Jaded Italian Morning-Glory-Pak-Bung Bruschetta
description: A nostalgic Neapolitan dish featuring bitter morning-glory-pak-bung, creamy sauce, and crispy bread, perfect for a diabetic-friendly breakfast or snack.
instructions: Toast Italian bread slices until lightly browned.
In a skillet, melt unsalted butter over medium heat. Add sliced garlic and saut1d until fragrant.
Add sliced fennel bulb to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in lemon juice, heavy cream, parmesan cheese, salt, and black pepper.
Add toasted bread slices to the skillet and spoon the fennel and cream sauce over the top.
Garnish with fresh parsley and basil leaves.
Transfer to a baking sheet and broil for 2-3 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
